axes.model_access: The main line is Tencent's self-developed Hunyuan (Hy) series — Tencent's official news page has model-iteration records (Hy3 preview released 2026-04-24 etc.); Yuanbao was early on known for "Hunyuan + DeepSeek dual-model switching", but current external promotion has converged onto the Hy series; the model selector is only visible after signing in and this site did not verify while signed in — go by what the signed-in UI actually shows.
axes.runtime: Web (yuanbao.tencent.com) + iOS/Android apps + PC/Mac clients, multi-surface; generation is processed on Tencent's cloud, no model runs locally. It and Tencent ima (a knowledge-base workbench) both belong to Tencent and both build on Hunyuan but are positioned differently — Yuanbao is a general assistant, ima is a personal knowledge-base RAG.
axes.local_files: Chat history and favorites are stored on the account side; deep document reading supports multiple formats and can process ultra-long single documents (official narrative); uploaded content is stored in the cloud account. No model runs locally — the client is just an entry.
axes.background: Chats return instantly with no official statement of an "offline continuation" form; deep thinking is an in-session reasoning tier, not an async task.
axes.tools: In-product capability lines incl. web search (exclusive WeChat Official Account / Channels sources are its differentiator), deep document reading, AI image generation, agent creation and AI coding (multi-language run-and-verify); integration with Tencent Docs / WeChat Read. No official statement verified for MCP support.
axes.context: Chat history syncs across devices when signed in; there is an "incognito temporary chat" (not saved to history after chatting); the cross-session long-term memory mechanism is not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Account system (WeChat/QQ/phone-number login); the training-use switch path not verified item by item. The Hunyuan model filing number is in the cn block (official disclosure).
axes.fit: Suits: people living in the WeChat ecosystem (searching Official Accounts/Channels, @ to interpret in comment sections, integrating Tencent Docs and WeChat Read), long-document deep reading, free quota. Does not suit: running models locally, or leaving the Tencent account system.

runs:
